purpose: Authoritative-source inventory and evidence gate for preliminary CLUP and zoning decision support in LOCUS-SF.

legal_position.required_notice: LOCUS-SF results are preliminary planning screens. Final zoning compatibility and locational clearance require review and action by the authorized LGU offices.

current_evidence_posture.explicit_map_statement: No authenticated official zoning map, zoning GIS dataset, georeferenced zoning raster, or parcel-level zoning geometry has been imported into LOCUS-SF.
current_evidence_posture.maximum_supported_claim: Source-cited preliminary screening based on verified ordinance text and explicitly identified amendments; not parcel-level zoning verification.

plan_horizon.caveat: The 2015-2024 planning horizon has elapsed. Horizon expiry does not by itself prove repeal or replacement of the zoning ordinance; current operative status must be certified by the City and Province.

sources.publisher: Sangguniang Panlungsod, City of San Fernando, La Union
sources.title: Sangguniang Panlungsod eArchives
verified_facts: The archive hosts the official PDF copies registered below for City Ordinances 2018-06, 2020-21, and 2025-16.
verification_caveats: Archive availability does not independently prove that every amendment, approval record, publication record, or map attachment has been located.
Use direct archive-document URLs and retained file hashes for production evidence packages.

sources.publisher: Sangguniang Panlungsod, City of San Fernando, La Union
sources.title: An Ordinance Adopting the Zoning Regulations of the City of San Fernando, La Union and Providing for Their Administration, Enforcement and Amendment
verified_facts: Section 1 identifies the enactment as the 2018 Zoning Ordinance of the City of San Fernando, La Union.
Section 3 relates the ordinance to the City's CLUP for 2015-2024.

The ordinance defines base zones, overlay zones, zone-specific uses, development controls, variances and exceptions, locational-clearance administration, enforcement, and a Local Zoning Board of Appeals.
Section 9 makes duly authenticated Official Zoning Maps an integral part of the ordinance.
verification_caveats: The duly authenticated Official Zoning Maps referenced by Section 9 have not been imported or publicly verified in this registry.
The CLUP horizon stated in the ordinance ended in 2024.
A complete effectivity, posting, publication, provincial-review, and amendment-chain package has not been imported.
The ordinance text alone cannot establish the zoning of a candidate parcel.

sources.publisher: Sangguniang Panlungsod, City of San Fernando, La Union
sources.title: Ordinance Amending Paragraph 15 of Section 10.B and Adding Paragraph 4 under Commercial Zone 1 of City Ordinance 2018-06
verified_facts: The amendment concerns Lots 15557, 15558, 15559, 15560, 15561, 15605, and 15606 under CAD 539-D in Barangay Namtutan.
The stated change is from Agricultural Zone to Commercial Zone 1.
The signed operative provisions state an affected area of 1.933 hectares.
verification_caveats: The document contains inconsistent affected-area figures; see contradiction area-2025-16.
A certified cadastral polygon and lot-to-map crosswalk have not been imported.
The ordinance states effectivity requirements, but proof that all posting, publication, and Local Government Code requirements were completed has not been imported.
The archive filename's 2026 date is an upload signal and must not be treated as the enactment date.

Draft or session numbering must not be substituted for the final enacted ordinance number.

sources.publisher: City Government of San Fernando, La Union
sources.title: Official City Announcement Recording the Contract to Update the CLUP and Zoning Ordinance
verified_facts: The City reports signing a contract with Palafox for updating the CLUP and Zoning Ordinance on December 6, 2024.
verification_caveats: An update contract is not evidence that a replacement CLUP or Zoning Ordinance has been adopted, approved, published, or made effective.
The page URL slug does not describe the CLUP update; provenance is the official City domain and inspected page content.

Further amending the composition of the City Planning Team.

verified_facts: The official index records continuing organizational work on the CLUP and Zoning Ordinance update through 2026.
verification_caveats: Planning-team executive orders do not enact or approve a CLUP or Zoning Ordinance.
The linked files are hosted on Google Drive but are linked from the official City index.

sources.publisher: City Planning and Development Office, City of San Fernando, La Union
sources.title: Issuance of Locational Clearances/Zoning Compliance Certificate for Buildings/Structures
verified_facts: The official process includes documentary evaluation, a zoning compatibility check, site inspection and report, fee assessment and payment where applicable, processing of the decision or certificate, and release.
The requirements vary with project circumstances and can include ownership evidence, plans, barangay clearance, highway clearance, and environmental compliance documents.
verification_caveats: The page cites City Zoning Ordinance 2001-007, which conflicts with the newer official archive record for City Ordinance 2018-06 and its amendments; see contradiction ordinance-reference-citizens-charter.
Published service times are administrative service standards, not proof that any candidate project is compliant.
LOCUS-SF cannot reproduce the official site inspection or authorized decision.

sources.publisher: City Planning and Development Office, City of San Fernando, La Union
sources.title: Issuance of Locational Clearances/Zoning Compliance Certificates for New Business Applicants
verified_facts: The official process includes checking the address and conformity with the CLUP and Zoning Ordinance before certificate preparation, approval, and release.
verification_caveats: The workflow confirms the need for authorized CPDO action and cannot be replaced by a software score.

sources.publisher: City Government of San Fernando, La Union
sources.title: City Departments - City Planning and Development Office
verified_facts: The City directory identifies the City Planning and Development Office and publishes cpdo@sanfernandocity.gov.ph and local numbers 120 and 156 as contact channels.
verification_caveats: Contact details should be rechecked on the official page before display or use.

sources.title: Executive Order No. 72, s. 1993
verified_facts: The order provides for CLUP implementation through zoning ordinances and provincial review and approval for component cities and municipalities.
It addresses devolution of locational-clearance functions subject to stated exceptions.
verification_caveats: This national framework does not identify a parcel's local zoning or replace the City's enacted ordinance and authenticated maps.

sources.title: Republic Act No. 7160 - Local Government Code of 1991
verified_facts: The Code establishes relevant LGU authority concerning comprehensive land-use planning, zoning ordinances, and land reclassification subject to legal limits.
verification_caveats: Zoning or local reclassification must not be represented as equivalent to Department of Agrarian Reform land-use conversion.

sources.title: Republic Act No. 8509 - Charter of the City of San Fernando
verified_facts: The law establishes San Fernando, La Union as a component city and continues it under the Province of La Union.
verification_caveats: The City's component-city status makes the applicable provincial review and approval record material to the CLUP/ZO evidence chain.

sources.title: Republic Act No. 11201 - Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development Act
verified_facts: The law transfers relevant land-use planning, monitoring, and zoning standards functions formerly associated with HLURB to DHSUD.
verification_caveats: National agency standards do not substitute for the locally enacted zoning ordinance, authenticated local maps, or LGU determination.

sources.publisher: Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development
sources.title: CLUP Guidebooks and Model Zoning Ordinance
verified_facts: The official guidebooks describe the CLUP process, sectoral analysis, base and overlay zones, zoning administration, and a model zoning ordinance.
The guidance supports geospatially precise boundary documentation and coordination between zoning and building administration.
verification_caveats: The Model Zoning Ordinance is guidance and is not San Fernando's local law.
The guidebooks cannot be used to invent local allowable-use rules absent the enacted local ordinance.

sources.publisher: Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development
sources.title: Revised Guidelines on the Review and Approval of Comprehensive Land Use Plans and Zoning Ordinances
verified_facts: The circular provides revised review and approval guidance for CLUPs and zoning ordinances, including those of component cities.
verification_caveats: The circular is procedural guidance and does not prove that San Fernando's specific plan or ordinance completed every required review and approval step.

No official public adoption, approval, effectivity, and publication package for a replacement plan or ordinance was verified by the research cutoff.

engine_governance.pass_rule: PASS may be used only as a preliminary screen after the current rule package, authenticated official map, parcel match, exact proposed use, applicable overlays, and amendment chain are all verified and no disqualifying condition is found.
engine_governance.conditional_rule: CONDITIONAL is limited to uses expressly allowed subject to identifiable ordinance conditions or outstanding mandatory evidence. It must not be used to imply automatic entitlement to a variance, exception, rezoning, reclassification, or land-use conversion.
engine_governance.fail_rule: FAIL may be used as a preliminary screen when a verified current rule expressly prohibits or excludes the exact proposed use for the authenticated parcel and applicable overlays.
engine_governance.strategic_corridor_rule: Strategic growth-corridor evidence may affect suitability or priority scoring but must never override zoning legality.
engine_governance.basemap_rule: Leaflet, OpenStreetMap, geocoded points, road corridors, and barangay labels are visualization or discovery aids only and are not official zoning evidence.
engine_governance.amendment_rule: Parcel-specific amendments require exact lot/title/cadastral matching; barangay-level or proximity-based application is prohibited.
